# dui

> Work in Progress template-driven UI library for Paper 26.2, Java 25 and unmodified Minecraft clients. Namespace: gg.kembel.dui. Built by Kembel Entertainment (https://kembel.gg).

## Documentation

- [Extensions](docs/extensions.md): Consumer-owned typed components/defaults, skins, glyphs and trusted shader contributions; no domain library edits.
- [Migration to 0.2](docs/migration-0.2.md): Breaking ownership/API/pack changes and replacement examples.

- [World maps](docs/world-map.md): Optional first-person camera backend, build-time geometry/fonts, frame/input APIs, shared pack, negative advances, hotbar zoom and cleanup.

- [Application API](docs/application-api.md): Controllers, typed actions/catalogues, lifetimes, profiles/collections, token styles, scene limits, generic motion, resource providers, pack contributions and test helpers.
- [Compatibility](docs/compatibility.md): WIP release matrix, protocol 4, schema fingerprints and explicit renderer boundaries, generated codec and validation.
- [Verification](docs/verification.md): Build/client acceptance evidence and measured limits.

- [Coding-agent guide](docs/llm-guide.md): Compact API contract, template semantics, lifecycle rules, media, pack deployment, limits and a reusable prompt. Start here when supplying dui context to an LLM.
- [First plugin](docs/quickstart.md): Complete Gradle, plugin.yml, config, XML and Java example with deployment steps.
- [README](README.md): Module overview, local Maven build, embedding and pack generation.
- [Components](docs/components.md): Per-component attributes, defaults, bounds, layout rules, action payloads and unsupported/unused parameters.
- [Application recipes](docs/recipes.md): Stateful controls with a complete controller, repeats, item/image/link keys, async updates, native forms, animated gifts, clipped carousels, deployment and troubleshooting. Include this for building consumer plugins.
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): Canvas rendering, font positioning, native model carriers and callback transport.
- [Rendering protocol](docs/rendering.md): Negative spacing with Unicode addresses and pen arithmetic, vertical band fonts, invisible hit spans, runtime rasters, native item/typed shader payload and debugging invariants. Include this for renderer or pack changes.
- [Composition and UI jobs](docs/composition.md): Implemented public components, props/outlets, relative layout, pagination, budgets and task scopes.
- [Abstraction roadmap](docs/roadmap.md): Audit evidence, delivery order, ownership, acceptance criteria and completed migration and explicit renderer boundaries.
- [dui-demo](https://github.com/Kembel-Entertainment/dui-demo): Companion consumer with examples and real-client integration tests.

Own code is MIT licensed. API and pack formats are provisional. No remote Maven release has been published. Check the source for the exact checked-out version; do not invent CSS, browser JavaScript or undocumented methods.

- World-map HUDs are consumer-owned dui-hud templates wrapping normal dui-menu components. Layout/style changes are runtime frame updates; static map art remains a pack-build input. See docs/world-map.md.

See [dynamic composition](docs/dynamic-composition.md) for measured/typed components, shared group geometry, RGBA/fonts, keyframes, runtime map layers, registered model cameras and trusted Paper backend extensions. Renderer/world-map protocol 4 packs must be rebuilt together with metadata.
